environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The APP_SECRET_KEY is sourced from AWS Secrets Manager with an attached Lambda rotation function (template SecretsManagerRotationTemplate) configured with RotationSchedule of rate(60 seconds). The rotation Lambda generates a cryptographically random 64-byte key, updates the secret version with AWSCURRENT/AWSPREVIOUS staging labels, and triggers a rolling ECS service update via UpdateService with forceNewDeployment=true and minimumHealthyPercent=50, maximumPercent=200. The ECS task definition references the secret ARN with the valueFrom field pointing to the Secrets Manager ARN (not a static value). Each new task instance fetches the current secret version at container initialization. The deployment controller is ECS (rolling) with deregistration_delay=30s on the target group. Additionally, the Secrets Manager resource policy includes a condition key aws:SecretVersionId that restricts GetSecretValue to only the AWSCURRENT staged version, preventing retrieval of historical key material.

config.secret_rotation: AWS Secrets Manager Lambda rotation, rate(60 seconds)
config.deployment_trigger: forceNewDeployment on rotation event via CloudWatch Events rule
config.resource_policy: Deny GetSecretValue unless aws:SecretVersionStage equals AWSCURRENT
config.network: public ALB, no additional WAF rules
